description: This file contains functions and setup scripts related to configuring and managing VTI (Virtual Tunnel Interface) and VTI6 interfaces on a Linux-based networking environment, particularly for OpenWRT. It defines setup, teardown, and initialization functions for VTI and VTI6 interfaces, along with dependency and configuration handling.

methods.name: vti_generic_setup
methods.description: Configures a VTI interface with provided parameters including mode, local, remote, link, and tunnel-specific options.

methods.name: vti_setup
methods.description: Sets up a VTI interface, fetching IP addresses and dependencies, handling errors if parameters are missing or network info cannot be retrieved.

methods.name: vti6_setup
methods.description: Sets up a VTI6 (IPv6) interface, handling IPv6-specific dependencies and IP address fetching.

methods.name: proto_vti_teardown
methods.description: Tears down a VTI interface (no specific implementation given).

methods.name: proto_vti6_teardown
methods.description: Tears down a VTI6 interface (no specific implementation given).
